product_offering.core_offering: Riskified provides an AI-powered ecommerce risk management platform that prevents online payment fraud, guarantees chargeback liability for approved orders, prevents policy abuse on refunds and returns, and secures customer accounts. Merchants integrate the platform into checkout flows to receive sub-second automated approve/decline decisions, with the company assuming full financial liability for any chargebacks on orders it approves under its performance-based transaction-fee model. The platform serves enterprise ecommerce merchants across retail, luxury fashion, travel, ticketing, digital goods, and marketplace verticals globally.
product_offering.differentiator: Riskified offers a chargeback guarantee model that shifts full financial liability for fraud chargebacks to Riskified, aligning incentives with merchant success. The platform processes billions of historical transactions across a global merchant network, providing unmatched fraud pattern intelligence. Sub-second real-time decisioning with 2-3X stronger fraud detection than baseline systems, along with explainable AI that provides context for every decision rather than blackbox outputs. The company pioneered AI-powered ecommerce fraud prevention in 2013 and now protects 3 of the top 10 largest ecommerce merchants globally.
product_offering.functional_benefit: Reduces total cost of fraud by up to 50%; increases sales approval rates by up to 20%; delivers sub-second fraud decisions; covers all chargeback liability under guarantee model; provides 2-3X stronger fraud and abuse detection; enables merchants to expand to new markets and verticals with confidence; reduces operational costs through automation; improves customer experience by eliminating false declines.
product_offering.problem_solved: Ecommerce fraud prevention, chargeback protection, false decline reduction, policy abuse detection, account takeover prevention, and merchant liability management. Riskified addresses the challenge that traditional fraud methods cannot adapt to the speed, scale, and sophistication of modern fraud and abuse, while merchants need to balance fraud prevention with customer experience and growth.

product_offering.product_overview: Riskified operates as a platform-plus-modules architecture providing AI-powered ecommerce risk management solutions. The core Riskified Platform powers the product portfolio through shared machine learning intelligence, a global merchant network with over a billion historical transactions, and identity graph capabilities. The main products include: Chargeback Guarantee (core fraud prevention with financial guarantee), Adaptive Checkout (dynamic checkout optimization), Policy Protect (refund/promo/reseller abuse prevention), Account Secure (account takeover protection), and Dispute Resolve (automated chargeback management). Additional AI-powered modules include Riskified ARIA (AI Risk Analyst) for conversational fraud analysis, Identity Explore 2.0 for identity intelligence, Decision Studio for policy configuration, and Dynamic Returns for AI-driven return decisions. The ecosystem also includes AI Agent Intelligence for securing merchant AI shopping assistants in agentic commerce scenarios.

company_assessment.market_position: Riskified (NYSE: RSKD) is a publicly traded AI-powered ecommerce fraud and risk intelligence company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, with US headquarters in New York. The company pioneered AI-led ecommerce fraud prevention and now protects 3 of the top 10 largest ecommerce merchants globally, serving enterprise merchants across retail, luxury fashion, travel, ticketing, digital goods, and marketplaces. Riskified operates globally with offices in Israel, US, Europe, APAC, LATAM, and India, and reported Q1 2026 revenue of $88.3 million with trailing twelve-month revenue of $344.6 million and 51.7% gross margin. The company maintains above 75% competitive win rate and 105% net dollar retention, reflecting strong enterprise market positioning in the ecommerce fraud prevention category.

strengths.details: With the launch of AI Agent Intelligence (HUMAN partnership, AI Agent Identity Signals, AI Agent Policy Builder), Riskified is positioned as a 'trust agent' for AI-mediated shopping — a category that barely existed two years ago. As agentic commerce scales, every AI-driven transaction will need identity verification and policy controls, opening a TAM that is currently uncaptured and unbounded by traditional ecommerce GMV.
strengths.headline: Agentic commerce creates greenfield fraud market

strengths.details: Riskified's billion-plus transaction dataset grows with every merchant onboarded, and Smart Linking identity clustering sharpens with each new node. As the merchant network expands across verticals and geographies (recent Outpayce airline deal, Japan expansion with Paygent/SB Payment Service/YTGATE), the marginal merchant adds disproportionately more predictive value, widening the moat against standalone competitors.
strengths.headline: Network effects compound data moat with each new merchant

strengths.details: With Chargeback Guarantee as the wedge, Riskified is layering Policy Protect (refund abuse, 20% avg savings), Account Secure (ATO), Dispute Resolve (5-minute dispute prep vs 30), Dynamic Returns, and ARIA/Decision Studio. Each module deepens account penetration and increases switching costs, with policy abuse and ATO representing multi-billion-dollar adjacent markets that the existing merchant base is already pre-qualified to buy.
strengths.headline: Platform upsell expands wallet share well beyond fraud

strengths.details: Adjusted EBITDA grew 370% YoY in Q1 2026 to $6.2M, with management guiding $28-34M for full-year 2026 (vs. prior years of consistent losses). Gross margin of 51.7% combined with largely fixed R&D and G&A infrastructure suggests significant incremental margins as revenue grows, with the platform increasingly self-funding its expansion.
strengths.headline: Operating leverage path to profitability accelerating

strengths.details: Co-founder/CEO Eido Gal and CTO Assaf Feldman (former MIT Media Lab researcher) remain in place post-IPO, providing continuity and technical depth. Recent executive additions (CMO Jeff Otto from Marqeta, President Ravi Kumaraswami from SAP Ariba/Crownpeak) bring public-company scaling experience that should support the next leg of growth.
strengths.headline: Founder-led execution with deep ML pedigree

weakness.details: Stripe Radar, Mastercard Fraud Intelligence, and Visa Cybersource increasingly bundle ML fraud detection into core processing at little or no incremental cost. As these incumbents extend capabilities, Riskified faces structural pressure on transaction-fee pricing and may be forced into a higher-cost sales motion against free or bundled alternatives, eroding the take-rate economics that drive the model.
weakness.headline: Network-embedded fraud tools compress pricing power

weakness.details: Revenue growth decelerated to 7% YoY in Q1 2026 from materially higher historical rates. If this reflects saturation of the addressable ecommerce chargeback guarantee market rather than macro noise, the bull thesis of compounding merchant expansion breaks down, and incremental growth must come from much smaller adjacency markets where Riskified has less competitive advantage.
weakness.headline: Slowing growth signals core market saturation

weakness.details: Under the chargeback guarantee, Riskified absorbs the full loss on approved orders that turn fraudulent. A coordinated attack exploiting a model blind spot, a major merchant data breach, or a sudden shift in fraud patterns (e.g., from synthetic identity AI) could trigger outsized losses in a single quarter, materially impacting earnings and capital reserves that support the guarantee.
weakness.headline: Liability model creates tail risk during coordinated fraud events

weakness.details: The customer base is heavily weighted to fashion (Prada, Lorna Jane, Steve Madden, Aldo, Gymshark, Revolve), luxury (SSENSE, Miu Miu, Canada Goose), and travel (Booking.com, Agoda, Air Europa). In a consumer downturn, these categories see sharper declines in discretionary GMV — and since Riskified's revenue is a take-rate on approved GMV, the company's top line would contract faster than overall payment volumes.
weakness.headline: Concentration in discretionary verticals amplifies cyclical exposure

weakness.details: Riskified has utilized $344.4M of its $375M (and now expanded $450M) share repurchase authorization, depleting substantial cash on buybacks despite ongoing GAAP losses. While supportive of EPS in the near term, this level of capital return signals that management sees limited high-return organic reinvestment opportunities, raising the question of whether growth investments are being underfunded.
weakness.headline: Aggressive buybacks signal lack of accretive reinvestment opportunities

competitive_moat.details: Riskified's proprietary ML models are trained on more than one billion historical transactions across its global merchant network, with hundreds of features analyzed per transaction in sub-second response times. This scale of guaranteed-approval data is difficult for newer entrants to replicate and improves accuracy for every additional merchant onboarded.

Every new merchant and transaction strengthens fraud detection accuracy for the entire network. Cross-merchant identity clustering via Smart Linking and Identity Explore 2.0 turns the merchant base into a collective intelligence asset, with 3 of the top 10 largest global ecommerce merchants already onboarded.

The chargeback guarantee model shifts full financial liability for fraud outcomes to Riskified, creating deep operational embedding in merchant checkout, customer service, and dispute workflows. Integration with Shopify, SAP, Salesforce, and Adobe Commerce creates technical switching friction in addition to commercial lock-in.

Riskified is embedded as a certified partner across the dominant ecommerce and payments stacks: Shopify Plus, SAP Commerce Cloud, Salesforce, Adobe Commerce, commercetools, AWS Marketplace, Stripe, Mastercard, and IATA. AWS Retail and CPG Competencies and Accelerate Partner status institutionalize this distribution at the platform level.

Proprietary explainable ML models, Smart Linking fraud-ring detection engine, and Identity Graph represent deep IP built over more than a decade. The above-75% competitive win rate and recognition via Juniper Research, MPE Awards, CNBC Top Fintech, and G2 Leader indicate durable brand authority in ecommerce risk.

key_risks.details: Riskified reported a $33.8M operating loss and $27.6M net loss in 2025, with EBITDA of -$31.3M. While adjusted EBITDA turned modestly positive in Q1 2026, GAAP profitability remains elusive, and the company continues to burn cash on a reported basis.
key_risks.headline: Persistent GAAP unprofitability with ongoing operating losses and negative net income

key_risks.details: Q1 2026 revenue grew only 7% year-over-year to $88.3M, well below historical growth rates. This deceleration, combined with prior years' slowing progression (from 2022's $261M to 2025's $344M), suggests competitive pressure or market maturity in core chargeback guarantee.
key_risks.headline: Slowing top-line growth signals potential saturation in core ecommerce fraud market

key_risks.details: By absorbing full chargeback liability on approved orders, Riskified takes on significant financial risk. A coordinated fraud attack, large merchant breach, or shift in fraud patterns could trigger outsized losses that are not capped and would directly hit earnings and capital reserves.
key_risks.headline: Chargeback guarantee model creates balance sheet liability exposure during fraud surges

key_risks.details: Riskified competes against Stripe Radar (bundled with Stripe payment processing), Mastercard fraud intelligence, Visa Cybersource, Signifyd, Forter, Sift, Kount (Equifax), and Accertify (American Express). Network- and processor-owned competitors have structural advantages in data and pricing power.
key_risks.headline: Intense competition from well-capitalized incumbents and specialist peers

key_risks.details: Major customers are concentrated in fashion (Prada, Lorna Jane, Gymshark, Steve Madden, Aldo), luxury (SSENSE, Miu Miu, Canada Goose), and travel (Booking.com, Agoda, Air Europa). These categories face sharper swings during economic downturns, creating revenue volatility.
key_risks.headline: Heavy customer concentration in discretionary verticals exposes revenue to consumer cyclicality

key_risks.details: Major payment networks and processors are embedding AI fraud detection into their rails at no incremental cost. As ML-driven fraud decisioning becomes table stakes, Riskified's premium pricing and dedicated-platform value proposition face structural pricing pressure.
key_risks.headline: AI commoditization risk as fraud detection becomes a baseline payment feature

key_highlights.details: Riskified assumes full financial liability for chargebacks on approved orders, only getting paid on orders that generate revenue. This liability-shift model creates deep switching costs, as merchants depend on Riskified's decisioning for operational workflows across checkout, customer service, and chargeback management.
key_highlights.headline: Differentiated chargeback guarantee model aligns incentives and locks in merchant partnerships

key_highlights.details: Riskified analyzes hundreds of millions of transactions across its global merchant network, with proprietary Smart Linking technology that detects fraud rings and emerging threats. Every new merchant improves detection accuracy for all network participants, generating strong data-driven competitive advantage.
key_highlights.headline: Network effects built on over a billion historical transactions create compounding data advantage

key_highlights.details: Q1 2026 results showed $88.3M revenue (+7% YoY), 13% GAAP gross profit growth to $45.9M, and adjusted EBITDA of $6.2M (up 370%). Management raised full-year 2026 guidance to $376-384M revenue and $28-34M adjusted EBITDA, with projected free cash flow growth of at least 20%.
key_highlights.headline: Improving profitability trajectory with adjusted EBITDA surging 370% YoY in Q1 2026

key_highlights.details: Riskified protects Booking.com, Prada, Lorna Jane, Rue Gilt Groupe, Finish Line, Gametime, Skullcandy, Gymshark, and other major brands. Net dollar retention was 105% in Q4 2025 and competitive win rate remains above 75%, signaling strong customer loyalty and expansion.
key_highlights.headline: Strong enterprise customer roster including 3 of top 10 global ecommerce merchants

key_highlights.details: Riskified reported $276.3M in cash with zero debt as of Q1 2026. The Board has authorized aggressive share repurchases totaling $450M (with $344.4M already utilized), reflecting strong management confidence in cash generation and undervaluation.
key_highlights.headline: Robust balance sheet with $276.3M cash and zero debt enables strategic flexibility

key_highlights.details: Product portfolio has expanded from Chargeback Guarantee to Policy Protect (refund/return abuse), Account Secure (ATO prevention), Dispute Resolve (chargeback automation), and AI Agent Intelligence (securing AI shopping assistants). This creates upsell opportunities into the existing base and reaches new budget owners.
key_highlights.headline: Platform expansion beyond core fraud unlocks new revenue vectors (policy abuse, returns, agentic commerce)

key_highlights.details: Riskified holds AWS Retail and CPG Competencies, is a certified Shopify Plus partner with native App Store listing, and has integrations with SAP Commerce Cloud, commercetools, Salesforce, and Adobe Commerce. Recent Outpayce (Amadeus) partnership opens airline vertical globally.
key_highlights.headline: Strategic partnerships with major commerce platforms embed Riskified as default fraud solution

customer_concentration.details: Riskified serves a broad enterprise portfolio across fashion (Prada, Miu Miu, SSENSE, Canada Goose, Lacoste, Steve Madden, Aldo, Revolve, Gymshark, Finish Line), travel (Booking.com, Agoda, Air Europa, Spring Airlines, Hotelogical), ticketing (TicketNetwork, Gametime, Super.com, Bilheteria), and electronics/retail (Ring, Skullcandy, Costway), with 3 of the top 10 global ecommerce merchants onboarded. No single customer is disclosed as exceeding material concentration thresholds; however, the enterprise-only motion and reliance on anchor logos (Booking.com, Prada) imply that loss of any top-10 account would be material. Net dollar retention of 105% in Q4 2025 and an above-75% competitive win rate indicate healthy diversification and limited churn risk in the near term. The performance-based pricing on approved GMV means revenue scales with merchant volume, providing natural downside protection if anchor merchants decline non-linearly.

peers.description: Signifyd is Riskified's closest direct competitor, offering a chargeback guarantee and fraud prevention platform specifically built for ecommerce merchants. Both companies pioneered the liability-shift model and compete head-to-head for enterprise retail and DTC customers across fashion, luxury, and electronics verticals.
peers.name: Signifyd

peers.description: Forter provides an enterprise Trust Platform for ecommerce fraud prevention, offering real-time decisioning and a chargeback guarantee for online merchants. It competes directly with Riskified across fashion, travel, digital goods, and marketplaces, with comparable ML-based decisioning and similar customer profiles.
peers.name: Forter

peers.description: Sift operates a Digital Trust & Safety platform combining fraud detection, account takeover prevention, and content abuse prevention for online businesses. While Sift does not offer a chargeback guarantee, it directly competes with Riskified in ML-driven fraud decisioning for ecommerce and digital goods merchants.
peers.name: Sift

peers.description: Kount, owned by Equifax, is an established ecommerce fraud and chargeback prevention platform serving merchants across verticals. As part of Equifax's broader identity and risk data portfolio, Kount competes with Riskified on ML-based decisioning and identity verification for enterprise merchants.
peers.name: Kount (Equifax)

peers.description: Accertify, an American Express company, provides fraud prevention, chargeback management, and dispute resolution solutions for enterprise merchants. Its parent company's network data gives it structural advantages analogous to Mastercard fraud intelligence, competing with Riskified in travel and large-enterprise segments.
peers.name: Accertify (American Express)

peers.description: Stripe Radar is a built-in ML fraud prevention product for merchants processing payments on Stripe, which Riskified actually integrates with as a channel partner. Radar's free or low-cost bundled pricing puts direct margin pressure on Riskified and represents the most significant structural competitive threat in the SMB and mid-market ecommerce segment.
peers.name: Stripe Radar

peers.description: Feedzai is a financial crime, risk, and fraud prevention platform serving banks, payment providers, and merchants globally. It overlaps with Riskified in transaction monitoring and ML-based decisioning, particularly for financial services and payments, though it extends further into AML and account-level risk.
peers.name: Feedzai

peers.description: Visa's Cybersource payment management platform includes Decision Manager, an ML-based fraud management solution used by large merchants globally. As a network-owned incumbent, Cybersource competes directly with Riskified for enterprise ecommerce fraud budgets, particularly for merchants already processing on Visa rails.
peers.name: Visa Cybersource

peers.description: Mastercard's fraud intelligence suite (including Ekata identity verification) provides network-level fraud signals and decisioning for merchants and issuers. Riskified already partners with Mastercard, but the network's ability to bundle fraud capabilities into core acceptance creates ongoing competitive pressure on standalone platforms.
peers.name: Mastercard Fraud Intelligence / Ekata

peers.description: DataVisor is an AI-powered fraud and AML platform using unsupervised ML to detect organized fraud attacks for financial institutions and large digital businesses. While more focused on financial services than ecommerce chargeback guarantee, it competes for the same enterprise fraud technology budget and ML-talent pool as Riskified.
peers.name: DataVisor
